name: Wild East Action Fund (land protection, conservation planning)
summary: Annual competitive grants for land protection and conservation planning projects within the Appalachian Trail landscape, from Georgia to Maine. The community resilience strand is not listed here.

amount.note: Land protection capped at 75,000; conservation planning 5,000 to 20,000

pool.label: the 2026 round
pool.note: Shared with the community resilience strand

status.quote: The application window for projects in land protection, conservation planning, and community resilience closed on June 26, 2026.

opens.quote: The grant application period for 2026 will open May 18 and will close June 26.

deadline.quote: The application window for projects in land protection, conservation planning, and community resilience closed on June 26, 2026.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include 501(c)(3) nonprofits, local, state, or Tribal agencies, and regional conservation partnerships that align with the mission and vision of the ATLP.

geography.quote: Awarded projects must benefit and occur within or overlap with the A.T. landscape

access.quote: The Wild East Action Fund is a private, competitive grant program administered by the Appalachian Trail Conservancy (ATC)

window.quote: The grant application period for 2026 will open May 18 and will close June 26.

amount.quote: Land protection requests are capped at $75,000, and conservation planning and community resilience requests are limited to single-year requests which may range from $5,000 to $20,000.

pool.quote: ATC is excited to announce that $1 million is available, in total, for qualified land protection, conservation planning, and community resilience projects.
